ai_summary: Here's an executive summary of the financial document:  Aksh Optifibre Limited reported a Q1 FY27 profit of Rs. 537.74 lakhs (standalone) despite being under a Corporate Insolvency Resolution Process (CIRP). A major red flag and material impact is the non-recognition of over Rs. 3,000 lakhs in liabilities related to government schemes, which, if recognized, would significantly reduce reported profit and inflate total liabilities, pending an uncertain amnesty scheme resolution. This non-recognition, alongside a substantial contingent liability from a corporate guarantee (Rs. 6,956.83 lakhs), raises serious concerns about the true financial health and sustainability of the recent profitability amidst the ongoing insolvency.
